subject: What needs another look?
preheader: If a bed, mattress or overnight setup is no longer working as expected, bring it back to us.
intro: You have worked with us before, so this is a straightforward check-in.
If a client's needs have changed, a setup needs adjustment or a new equipment brief has become complicated, David and Alex want to help.
sectionTitle: The next brief can start with what has changed
body: A different transfer, a change in support, reduced room access or a mattress that is no longer meeting the person's needs can alter the whole setup.
We can help review the equipment question, organise another home trial or coordinate the bed, mattress and related equipment around the current requirement.
questions: A previous setup now needs adjustment or review.
A new bed or mattress brief needs to be tested at home.
Several equipment decisions need to be coordinated together.
actionTitle: What are you working on now?
actionText: Reply with the person's goals, what is difficult in the current setup and what has changed. David or Alex will come back to you and work through the most useful next step.
teamName: The Sleep Choice x Supply Ministry Team
trialFooterText: Seven-night in-home trial availability, service area, equipment configuration and individual arrangements are confirmed per case.
